method.name: Lake Tefé and the Middle Solimões

reviewed.note: Water from the bay east of Vista Alegre towards Canaman at least 300 m wide on Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 of 30-31 Aug; the reference's narrowing under 60 m at -3.41711, -64.80745 is mixed shore pixels.

River over 100 m wide at -3.17267, -64.52071 and -3.17321, -64.51927 on Sentinel-1 (10 m) of 20 Oct and Sentinel-2 of 24 Oct. As near Monte Sinai, the Sentinel-2 cloud mask left only the 30 m DSWx products to vote, which narrowed the river to 40-57 m.

Parana Copea continuous and over 100 m wide on the clear Sentinel-2 image of 21 Oct, also at the bend at -3.18383, -64.57345 where DSWx-S1 saw land. The Sentinel-2 cloud mask flagged the reach as cloud, so only the 30 m DSWx products voted and narrowed the river to 40-57 m.
